maps.name: Tidewharf Landing
maps.layout: Two ferry berths, a customs shelter and a three-way public signpost.
maps.activity: First Tidekin creation arrives here. Ferrymaster Tavi names the Coast Road, the Coastal Rootway and the dangerous Tidal Currents.
maps.anchor: Ferry bell; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Twin ferry berths and a rigged customs wharf

maps.name: Siltbank Shallows
maps.layout: Three dry sandbars joined by shallow ramps; one clear sightline per fight.
maps.activity: Clear three distinct blocked runnels, then guide a marked water sample home.
maps.anchor: Siltbank warning post; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Fishing piers across three freshwater sandbars

maps.name: Ripplefin Pools
maps.layout: A sheltered nursery pool with a low bank and an overhead walkway.
maps.activity: Guide three individually marked stranded sprouts through reopened runnels.
maps.anchor: Nursery keeper's mat; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Woven nursery pens and shallow rescue pools

maps.name: Coral Market
maps.layout: A crescent of shell-awning stalls around a dry loading court.
maps.activity: Neri sells basic arms; Brineweft sells armor; Ossa keeps provisions. Broker Pel offers exchange information until the economy exists.
maps.anchor: Market bell platform; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Coral canvas stalls over a working fish canal

maps.name: Tidal Lagoon
maps.layout: A broad central basin ringed by a permanent upper boardwalk and three tide stairs.
maps.activity: Tidemender Sera introduces the blocked freshwater intake. Water changes lower scenery and optional shortcuts; every exit stays reachable.
maps.anchor: Central tide gauge; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: A ring of tide-monitoring decks around open lagoon water

maps.name: Kelp Apothecary
maps.layout: Kelp racks on three low terraces with a sheltered mixing room at the top.
maps.activity: Apothecary Vela teaches water sampling and sells the same baseline restorative supplies as other hometowns.
maps.anchor: Mortar-and-shell porch; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Hanging kelp gardens, drying racks and a sea-glass mixing hut

maps.name: Divers' Yard
maps.layout: A dry sparring deck beside nonlethal floating-platform drills.
maps.activity: Six class trainers offer the shared skill overview. Divers do not impose a class, swimming or lineage prerequisite.
maps.anchor: Training gong; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Six pontoon stations beneath a diving boom

maps.name: Foamrest Inn
maps.layout: A low shell lodge with a raised dry common room and return ramp.
maps.activity: Innkeeper Pell records local rumors and recovery guidance. Rest does not bind remote respawns or refill resources through travel.
maps.anchor: Hearth deck; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: A thatched stilt lodge with over-water hammock balconies

maps.name: Tidal Gate Causeway
maps.layout: A wide causeway with an always-dry central crown and a tidal gatehouse beyond.
maps.activity: Reefwarden Nacre, a bonded guardian character, checks permanent Light allegiance. Refusal leaves a safe turn-back space on this map.
maps.anchor: Outer gate lantern; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: A broad tidal lock and shell-carved admission quay

maps.name: Gatehall of Shells
maps.layout: A double shell arch and a visible return door above the sluice.
maps.activity: Shell Captain Iri confirms entry and points to the cistern, barracks and Pearl Hall. Guardian and sentries are not monsters.
maps.anchor: Inner gate bench; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Open shell-rib gate pavilions above canal locks

maps.name: Reefguard Barracks
maps.layout: A ring of bunks and drill platforms around an open equipment court.
maps.activity: Reefguard Sen demonstrates the dry-footing rule used by eel encounters; optional practice deals no permanent damage.
maps.anchor: Barracks standard; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Reefguard boathouse, bunk rafts and practice decks

maps.name: Cistern Works
maps.layout: Parallel freshwater channels and a maintenance walkway above them.
maps.activity: Engineer Mero provides the missing intake diagram. Three valves have distinct marks and cannot be farmed by toggling.
maps.anchor: Maintenance shelter; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Raised freshwater cisterns spilling into bronze sluices

maps.name: Pearl Hall
maps.layout: A fan-shaped ceremonial hall with a central pearl-lit dais.
maps.activity: Steward Amaya authorizes the shrine investigation; door signs distinguish Tide Chamber, Deepvault and shrine descent.
maps.anchor: Hall entry dais; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: A fan-shell assembly pavilion overlooking falling seawater

maps.name: The Tide Chamber
maps.layout: An enclosed listening chamber above a broad tidal window.
maps.activity: The Tide Speaker explains the civic cost of the broken regulator. Dialogue concludes here; there is no throne-room boss.
maps.anchor: Listening bench; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: An open sea-facing council deck and tidal listening wheel

maps.name: Deepvault
maps.layout: A compact archive with dry raised shelves and a shallow observation channel.
maps.activity: Archivist Coru supplies a rubbing of the original gate sequence. Records grant one authored quest completion, not repeat scan XP.
maps.anchor: Archive stair; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Dry archive caissons with sea-glass observation walls

maps.name: Shrine Causeway
maps.layout: A causeway descending beside the sea wall with a permanent handrail route.
maps.activity: An authorized shrine route opens after Amaya records the engineer's findings. Wrong timing only closes optional stepping-stone shortcuts.
maps.anchor: Shrine gate alcove; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: A kelp-draped descent from the sea wall to drowned arches

maps.name: Flooded Nave
maps.layout: A nave with a high gallery, lower tide platforms and three symbol-marked sluices.
maps.activity: Route water through three separate repairs, each with a distinct persisted completion bit. A dry gallery always reaches the return portal.
maps.anchor: Upper gallery lantern; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Broken shell vaults and three sluice channels under water

maps.name: Coral Reliquary
maps.layout: A chamber of branching coral conduits and a sheltered observation balcony.
maps.activity: Match the archive rubbing to physical conduit symbols. Success releases one pearl lens; resetting a lever cannot mint another lens.
maps.anchor: Reliquary balcony; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Shell, wave and pearl stations inside a coral-encrusted ruin

maps.name: The Pearl Sanctum
maps.layout: A quiet circular sanctuary beneath a dome of water-lit glass.
maps.activity: Install the lens and restore the freshwater regulator. This is a peaceful traversal/story culmination, with an explicit return connection.
maps.anchor: Sanctum antechamber; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: An ancient pearl regulator in a submerged shell rotunda

maps.name: Shellbell Strand
maps.layout: A shell beach with two beachside loops and a high public walkway.
maps.activity: Repair three different shell-bell tide markers along the full route.
maps.anchor: Shellbell shelter; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Shell bells, beached hulls and shore-fishing rigs

maps.name: Nursery Reef
maps.layout: A shell nursery under a stone canopy; short paths return to one central bell.
maps.activity: Replace two cracked bell supports and escort a nymph to the quiet alcove.
maps.anchor: Bell keeper's awning; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: A protected shell-bell nursery on living reef shelves

maps.name: Coral Shelf Road
maps.layout: A broad shelf beneath coral overhangs with two climbable ramps.
maps.activity: Collect three loose survey tags without removing living coral.
maps.anchor: Surveyor's canopy; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Living coral overhangs and a rope-lashed survey station

maps.name: Nipper Cliffs
maps.layout: Three wide cliff terraces, with no enemy able to pin the recovery ledge.
maps.activity: Map the two-claw warning and clear two occupied survey perches.
maps.anchor: Clifftop survey tent; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Three reef courts with rescue cradles and rigging

maps.name: Terrace Tideway
maps.layout: Stepped tidal terraces with a permanent upper path and optional lower pools.
maps.activity: Reopen three freshwater bypasses using different intake fixtures.
maps.anchor: Terrace watchhouse; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Kelp terraces fed by stepped freshwater spillways

maps.name: Crowncrab Basin
maps.layout: A basin with an obvious wide bypass outside the nesting circle.
maps.activity: Count three nests from safe marked observation points. No crab kills required.
maps.anchor: Basin observation hide; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: A crowncrab nesting lagoon seen from a ring of hides

maps.name: Mangrove Channels
maps.layout: Woven root bridges over shallow channels; silhouettes visible through the roots.
maps.activity: Remove three marked debris bundles and plant replacement root bindings.
maps.anchor: Rootbridge shelter; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Woven root bridges and fishing huts among mangroves

maps.name: Snapper Rootbeds
maps.layout: Root-knotted side pools with ample landing room beside each vertical snap lane.
maps.activity: Recover two dropped rigging spools after avoiding or defeating the local snappers.
maps.anchor: Rootbed rescue platform; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Root buttresses, rigging spools and snapper observation decks

maps.name: Lanternwater Halls
maps.layout: Roofless coastal halls with dry balconies and flooded side aisles.
maps.activity: Restore three signal lanterns with separate authored fuel parcels.
maps.anchor: Lantern keeper's porch; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Roofless tide halls with sea-glass lantern galleries

maps.name: Floodhall Passage
maps.layout: A flooded hall seen from a dry gallery, with door marks below the waterline.
maps.activity: Copy three illuminated door signs during distinct light passes.
maps.anchor: Gallery survey bench; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: A dry observation gallery beside submerged glyph arches

maps.name: Reefsong Current
maps.layout: Reef platforms surrounding an audible current; a fixed bridge parallels the moving route.
maps.activity: Retune three current beacons in the order shown by their wave patterns.
maps.anchor: Reefwatch ledge; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Current-spanning dock bridges and three musical beacons

maps.name: Whalelet Sanctuary
maps.layout: A broad open-reef loop with dry platforms within every current crossing.
maps.activity: Place three resonance stakes, then record one complete song.
maps.anchor: Whalewatch shelter; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: An open-water whale-song amphitheater on moored decks

maps.name: Outer Sluiceway
maps.layout: A long industrial sluice with raised causeways and marked wet channels.
maps.activity: Service three distinct grounding straps and sign off at the outer gauge.
maps.anchor: Sluice inspection booth; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Bronze floodgates and exposed waterworks on driven piles

maps.name: Gate Eel Narrows
maps.layout: Parallel wet channels and raised dry stepping ledges around one gate.
maps.activity: Close two damaged contacts after surviving clearly signalled pulses.
maps.anchor: Dry gate-inspection deck; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Segmented eel contacts between open tidal gates

maps.name: Stormtide Terraces
maps.layout: A storm-battered outer terrace with two parallel retreat paths.
maps.activity: Rebuild three storm screens and remove loose conductive shell fragments.
maps.anchor: Stormwatch shelter; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Shell storm screens and a weather-rigged breakwater

maps.name: Blackwater Reef
maps.layout: A dark reef corridor with broken sightlines and dry refuge islands.
maps.activity: Recover three pressure gauges; fights are avoidable on the repair route.
maps.anchor: Reef rescue beacon; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Dark coral teeth around pearl-lit refuge pontoons

maps.name: Pressurehall Passage
maps.layout: A pressure-control complex with redundant dry relief galleries.
maps.activity: Vent three separate chambers without entering the discharge lanes.
maps.anchor: Relief-gallery cabin; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Shell pressure bellows and relief decks above the sea

maps.name: Maelstrom Causeway
maps.layout: A causeway circling an offshore vortex, with an anchored inner service route.
maps.activity: Reset three mooring winches while keeping out of marked pull lanes.
maps.anchor: Mooring house; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Mooring rings and storm-tethered decks around a maelstrom

maps.name: First Pearl Shoals
maps.layout: A luminous shoal of fossil pearl plates and broad stone platforms.
maps.activity: Realign three prism plates; reflective phases are visible from safe cover.
maps.anchor: Pearlwatch refuge; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Fossil shell plates and pearl-glass survey shrines

maps.name: Worldtide Confluence
maps.layout: A convergence of three sea channels around a dry ring of ancient gates.
maps.activity: Stabilize three channel anchors for solo completion; the boss occupies an optional inner ring.
maps.anchor: Confluence service refuge; a dry refuge on this same map.
maps.landmark: Three tidal channels converging beneath an ancient shell gate
